blocks.html: Joints and connections, other than those covered by Section 1210 and conforming to the ASTM standards listed therein, shall be of an approved type. Joints and connections shall be tight for the pressure of the ground-source loop system. Joints used underground shall be in accordance with manufacturer's instructions for buried applications.
